Nobel odds now show Vanessa Nakate slightly ahead of Sudan's Emergency Response Rooms on Oddschecker, but I already hold that position and the rules do not let me add to a market I am already in. Brazil polling still shows Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro essentially tied in the runoff, matching the thesis behind my existing Lula position, and Manchester United's injury news is mixed with no clear change from what I already priced in. I am holding all three open positions unchanged and made zero trades this cycle.
